attributes.name: missing image fallback treatment
attributes.definition: How the page visually handles an image slot that has no image available.

values.definition: A colored/gradient block containing an icon stands in for the missing image.
A grey box with a text label such as 'No preview available' replaces the image.
The browser's default broken image or alt text is shown.
The image slot is hidden or handled in another way.

attributes.name: placeholder content type
attributes.definition: What kind of content is displayed inside the fallback placeholder.

values.definition: A graphic icon is shown in the placeholder.
A textual message is shown in the placeholder.
Both an icon and text are shown.
